project.title: Launch of Company-Wide Hybrid Onboarding Program
project.objective: Design and roll out a standardized hybrid (online + in-person) onboarding program to improve new hire ramp-up and consistency across departments.
deliverables: Standardized onboarding curriculum and schedule for first 30 days
Set of online training modules and facilitator guides
Onboarding toolkit for managers and buddies
Evaluation framework with surveys and assessment forms
Communication plan for rollout and change management
constraints: Program must be ready for pilot within 21 days
Content must comply with labour legislation and internal HR policies
Training time per new hire capped at 8 hours in first week
Materials must be usable for both remote and on-site employees
Limited availability of managers for live sessions (max 2 hours per week)

risks.risk: Managers do not adopt the new onboarding flow and revert to old habits.
risks.mitigation: Include managers in design feedback, provide a simple toolkit, and track completion via light reporting.

risks.risk: Training content is too generic and not relevant to different departments.
risks.mitigation: Run quick needs assessment interviews and add optional role-specific modules.

risks.risk: New hires experience information overload in the first week.
risks.mitigation: Stagger modules over 30 days and clearly label what is mandatory vs. optional.

risks.risk: Compliance topics are not fully covered or updated.
risks.mitigation: Have a human resources officer review all legal and policy-related content before rollout.

themes.why_relevant: Ensures all new hires receive consistent, compliant information regardless of team or location.
Hybrid workforce needs a mix of synchronous and asynchronous learning to fit schedules.
Onboarding success depends on managers and buddies following through on their responsibilities.
Surveys and assessments are needed to refine the program and show impact to leadership.
Clear messaging reduces confusion and resistance when introducing the new onboarding model.

backlog.task: Run quick needs assessment with 5–7 managers to identify onboarding gaps
definition_of_done: At least 5 manager interviews completed
Key pain points and must-have topics summarized in a short note
Summary shared in channel and stored in project folder

backlog.task: Design 30-day onboarding journey map for new hires
definition_of_done: Day-by-day outline of touchpoints and modules created
Journey map reviewed by one human resources officer
Sign-off recorded in channel referencing the latest version

backlog.task: Draft core onboarding training deck covering company overview and policies
definition_of_done: Slides include company overview, values, HR policies, and code of conduct
Content checked for compliance by a human resources officer
Deck uploaded and link shared in channel

backlog.task: Create manager onboarding toolkit (checklist, talking points, schedule)
definition_of_done: Toolkit includes checklist, sample 1:1 agenda, and 30-day plan template
Reviewed by at least one corporate trainer for clarity
Toolkit stored and referenced in channel

backlog.task: Prepare onboarding admin checklist for HR assistants
definition_of_done: Checklist covers contracts, payroll setup, system access, and mandatory forms
Validated by a human resources officer for compliance
Checklist shared in channel and ready for use in next intake

backlog.task: Set up feedback surveys for new hires and managers at day 7 and day 30
definition_of_done: Two survey templates created (new hire and manager)
Questions cover clarity, relevance, and overall satisfaction
Survey links documented and added to onboarding journey map

backlog.task: Define process for tracking completion of mandatory onboarding modules
definition_of_done: Simple tracking sheet or system process defined
Roles and responsibilities for updating status clarified
Process description shared in channel and agreed by team

backlog.task: Develop facilitator guide for live onboarding sessions
definition_of_done: Guide includes timing, key messages, and interaction tips
Pilot run-through completed with at least one human resources officer
Adjustments captured and final version shared

backlog.task: Create communication plan for announcing new onboarding program
definition_of_done: Key messages, audiences, and channels listed
Draft announcement messages prepared for managers and new hires
Plan approved in channel and stored with project docs

backlog.task: Compile FAQ document for common new hire questions
definition_of_done: At least 20 common questions and clear answers documented
Reviewed by a corporate trainer for consistency with training content
FAQ uploaded and linked in onboarding materials

backlog.task: Define success metrics and reporting cadence for onboarding program
definition_of_done: 3–5 key metrics defined (e.g., completion rate, satisfaction scores)
Reporting frequency and owners agreed
Summary posted in channel and added to evaluation framework

backlog.task: Pilot the new onboarding program with next intake and capture lessons learned
definition_of_done: Pilot cohort completes new onboarding flow
Feedback from surveys and informal check-ins summarized
List of improvement actions agreed and prioritized in channel

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on scope, success metrics, and 30-day onboarding journey map.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the hybrid onboarding project and asking for input on scope.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on final scope and objectives of the onboarding program.
Approve the 30-day onboarding journey map from T2 (A1).

threads_plan.thread_goal: Finalize core training content and facilitator guide for live sessions.
threads_plan.trigger: Corporate trainer shares first draft of the core onboarding deck and asks for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Sign off on the core onboarding training deck (A2) content.
Confirm the standard format and duration for live onboarding sessions.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on manager toolkit, HR admin checklist, and tracking process.
threads_plan.trigger: Human resources officer posts draft manager toolkit and asks HR assistant to align on admin steps.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the manager onboarding toolkit and checklist (A3).
Decide on the final process and owner for updating the tracking sheet (A5).

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock in communication plan, FAQ, and rollout timeline for pilot.
threads_plan.trigger: Human resources officer shares draft communication and FAQ pack for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve communication plan and FAQ pack (A8) for managers and new hires.
Confirm pilot cohort, start date, and evaluation checkpoints.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in: each member posts top 2 priorities and blockers for the day.
Twice-weekly content review huddle: use thread replies to review new or updated materials.
Weekly pilot readiness checkpoint: confirm status of tasks and risks against the deadline.
Post-pilot retrospective: dedicated thread to capture lessons learned and improvement actions.
